_doc: The ratchet floor, not a cache: pnpm score:primitives fails when the run loses anything here. matrix holds one line per row, five cells in the order format renderer canvas panel ai: "pass" must stay a pass, "-" holds nothing yet, and a gap id is a cell lowered on purpose, which must stay that gap and needs its reason in lowered. pnpm score:primitives --update-baseline only raises: it turns "-" into "pass" and adds passing fixtures and cases, and it writes nothing when the run dropped. Lowering is a hand edit in the same pull request as its cause: the row gets the gap id and lowered gets the reason. pnpm check:score-floor checks this file against latest.json row by row.

lowered.css-selector:::picker(): Refused on purpose by #271 (fix(consent): keep every stored layer below the consent banner). A customizable select's ::picker(select) draws in the top layer, above every z-index and so above the consent banner, and the consent runtime's guard cannot see it: styled to fill the screen, one tap covered the banner in Chromium and WebKit, and in WebKit no tap closed it. The rules parser refuses ::picker( in a selector on every path, so the row is top-layer-refused in all five columns.
